sources: audit/state_park_fees/wv_booking_prices_2026-10-12.json (book.wvstateparks.com, Coopers Rock State Forest Electric Campsites [McCollum] and Non-electric Campsites [Rhododendron], nights of 2027-04-20 and 2027-06-15, read 2026-10-12)

values.note: McCollum (the RV campground) electric sites $41.99-$47.99 a night on the WV State Parks booking site (2027 weeknights, read 2026-10-12). The $31.99 non-electric sites are Rhododendron, which is tent/hammock only.

fees.source: audit/state_park_fees/wv_booking_prices_2026-10-12.json (book.wvstateparks.com: 'Site N, McCollum, Electric' $41.99 x21, $44.99 x3, $47.99 x25; 'Site N, Rhododendron, Non-electric' $31.99) + https://wvstateparks.com/parks/coopers-rock-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-coopers-rock-state-forest/ ('The campground is open to only tent/hammock camping' [Rhododendron]), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Both campgrounds open by the first weekend in April. McCollum (RV) stays open until the first Saturday of December, weather permitting; Rhododendron (tents) closes on the first Saturday in November.

season.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/coopers-rock-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-coopers-rock-state-forest/ ('The campgrounds are open by the first weekend in April. Rhododendron Campground closes for the season on the first Saturday in November through the end of the year. McCollum Campground remains open until the first Saturday of December, weather permitting.'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/coopers-rock-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-coopers-rock-state-forest/ ('McCollum Campground offers 25 sites with electric hookups (30 amp)'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: McCollum: 25 electric sites for RVs, trailers, 5th wheels, tents and truck/van camping. Rhododendron's 25 primitive sites are tent/hammock only.

sites.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/coopers-rock-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-coopers-rock-state-forest/ ('McCollum Campground can accommodate RVs, trailers, 5th wheels, tents, and truck/van camping'; 'Rhododendron Campground offers 25 primitive campsites ... open to only tent/hammock camping'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: McCollum: central bathhouse with showers and laundry, water at several faucets, Wi-Fi for registered guests, campground store (firewood, ice, gifts). Rhododendron: central bathroom with flush toilets.

facilities.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/coopers-rock-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-coopers-rock-state-forest/ ('A central bathhouse is available with showers, laundry and water at several faucets around the campground. Wi-Fi is available for registered campground guests', 'available for purchase in the campground store', 'A central bathroom with flushing toilets and running water'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve on the WV State Parks booking site or through the forest office, 304-594-1561. Weekend (Friday and Saturday) reservations need both nights; one night Sunday-Thursday.

booking.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/coopers-rock-state-forest/lodging/camping-at-coopers-rock-state-forest/ ('call the forest office at 304-594-1561 for more information and reservations', 'Reservations may be made for no less than two consecutive nights on weekends (Friday and Saturday) or one night Sunday through Thursday', 'There is a 14-night maximum stay'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Changed fees base $31.99 -> $41.99 (high $47.99) and cleared the +$10 electric surcharge: the non-electric $31.99 sites are Rhododendron, tent/hammock only, so the cheapest site a 23-ft rig fits is a McCollum electric site. Added season (early April - first Saturday of December for McCollum), 30-amp electric, 25 RV sites, showers/flush toilets/water/laundry/wifi/store. Confirmed the inherited reservable/2-night weekend minimum/14-night max. Not stated: water/sewer at sites, max rig length, dump.
flags: Website carries a CampLife link (https://www.camplife.com/campground/Coopers+Rock+State+Forest) that is not the forest's booking channel: wvstateparks.com sends reservations to the forest office (304-594-1561) and the WV State Parks booking site lists McCollum and Rhododendron sites. Looks like a directory listing; drop it unless someone confirms CampLife books Coopers Rock.
